text: Entry Requirements International qualifications Preliminary year(year one entry) GCSE/IGCSE/O levels Normally a minimum of five B grades including Bs in relevant subjects. Qualifying year(year two entry) A levels Typical A level requirements are ABB/BBB for the majority of programmes. Relevant subjects vary for each programme. International Baccalaureate (IB)Diploma Typical requirements are 28-34 points, with Higher Level subjects and grades required for particular programmes. Advanced Placements(APs) Typical requirements range from 4,4,4-5,5,4. English Language Requirements Preliminary year IELTS 5.5 with no less than 5.0 in any element PTE Academic 59(minimum 53) TOEFLiBT 72(minimum 14 in Reading,15 in Listening,19 in Speaking and 16 in Writing) Qualifying year IELTS 6.5 with the Writing band no less than 6.0 PTE Academic 71(minimum 65) TOEFLiBT 90(minimum 19 in Writing)
